page.overview:
Who is Pipp Petals?

Princess Pipp Petals, full name Philomena Petals, is a female Pegasus pony and one of the main characters of My Little Pony: A New Generation and My Little Pony Generation 5. She is a princess of Zephyr Heights, Zipp Storm's younger sister, Queen Haven's youngest daughter, and a famous pop singer and social media influencer.__TOC__

Pipp Petals was designed by character artist Celia Kaspar. Hasbro filed trademarks for the names "Pipp Petals" and "Princess Petals" with the United States Patent and Trademark Office on February 25, 2021.

Her full first name is the same as that of Princess Celestia's pet phoenix.

In My Little Pony: A New Generation, Pipp appears as a princess of Zephyr Heights, pop singer, and social media celebrity. Sunny Starscout and Izzy Moonbow arrive in Zephyr Heights on the day of a royal celebration, during which Pipp is scheduled to debut a brand new song. When Sunny and Izzy are brought before Pipp and her mother Queen Haven and sister Zipp Storm, Pipp reveals their presence to the entire city through social media (to her mother's chagrin). She later visits Sunny and Izzy in the dungeons ("For the content") and tells them that the royal family are the only Pegasi able to fly, though Zipp later reveals this to be a falsehood used to give the citizens hope.
